description.en:
The Emperor of the Empire of Atlantis, Thalassa, in the depths of the sea. Contrary to her belief that days of abundance and happiness would continue,
she was betrayed by her lover and friend, and sealed away for a thousand years.

And when she opened her eyes again...

"I, who was once the great Emperor of the glorious empire, have become a baby as small as a baby crab!"

Atlantis had already perished, and Thalassa was reborn as the baby princess and dragon heiress of the kingdom established by the traitors!

What's more? The dragon heiress has to marry the crown prince to break the curse?

"You scoundrels!"

Not only did she have to uncover the secrets of Atlantis's demise,
but she found herself destined to marry the crown prince against her will.

"I have no choice. I'll just stay with them until the curse on the crown prince is lifted!"
description.pl:
Pewnego dnia zostaje zdradzona i zapieczętowana przez swojego kochanka i przyjaciółkę, których kochała.
I od tego czasu minęło tysiąc lat.
Tarassa, nie, zostałam reinkarnowana jako księżniczka Nisseph w kraju, który stworzyli!
'Czy to ma sens?!'
Byłam cesarzem wielkiego imperium!
Ale stałam się dzieckiem tak małym jak krabik!
'Uh-huh, ciało Jima nie ma sensu...'
"Księżniczka stanie się Księciem Smoczej Korony, który zakończy wszystkie te klątwy zgodnie z wyrocznią".
Jednak aby złamać klątwę przekazywaną od tysiąca lat, musi być związana z Księciem Korony.
'To jest ofiara z człowieka. To jak ukwiecenie, ale...'
"Jeśli ty jesteś morzem, ja stanę się Gwiazdą Północną, która świeci tylko na ciebie".
"...Zion."
"Życie bez ciebie jest nic nie warte".
Współczuję Księciu Korony cierpiącemu z powodu klątwy.
Muszę odkryć tajemnicę dnia, w którym zostałam zapieczętowana...
Posiedźmy tutaj jeszcze chwilę!

description.ko: Nam Yoomin, a full time department store worker, begins to feel skeptical about her own life. She decides to quit her job due to a conflict with her manager. However, when she enters the manager's office. She comes face to face with the manager who has now turned into a monster. Yoo Min immediately runs away from the manager, but encounters another monster and faces danger once again. Outside the department store, a world experiencing doom had already begun unfolding.

description.en: "I'm sorry…" The second year of high school enters the new semester after the time when Juyeon and Mihyang, who became awkward with the rejected confession, avoided each other due to misunderstandings and worries. The two meet again, and with a fluttering heart, a slightly different special story begins. From the thrilling confession to the day when the first snow falls for the two, <685 days>

Certan was the prince of the demon world who wrecked havoc a long time ago. His father, the king of the demon world, had his soul sealed in an octagonal tablet and he sent to the human world…

By accident, he got stuck with a boy named Go Jinyoung…

‘Let’s conquer the martial world with magic!’

The popular martial arts novel, Magic Scholar, returns as a webtoon!

description.pt-br: Com um novo ano eletivo, Eunwoo termina se sentando perto da Jinah uma garota sombria e pouco sociável, em uma tentativa de se aproximar da sua colega acaba em uma situação muito mais complexa do que poderia imaginar. Uma história sobre os desafios das emoções da juventude, uma obra de estreia de Lame!

description.en: High school senior Min-kyum has been left to his own defenses after his parents kicked him out of their lives. His new house is in a shabby neighborhood, the site of several mysterious assaults that have left victims with bite marks on their necks and blood loss symptoms. After moving in, Min-kyum heads out for a meal…then somehow wakes up at home with strange marks on his neck. He tries to shrug it off, but his deskmate at the new school looks suspiciously pale and familiar…
description.pl: Park Min Gyeom jest człowiekiem cierpiącym na chorobę, przez którą jego ciało produkuje nadmierne ilości krwi. Kim Chun Sam jest dhampirem, który potrzebuje krwi by przeżyć. Tak rozpoczyna się niezwykła symbioza pomiędzy "drapieżnikiem" i "ofiarą".

description.en: Climbing to the top of Heaven’s castle will prove a herculean task, for the one who can reach the summit shall be granted control of the world.
My life has been sold to two different people. Now I have to live as a different person in the day and night.

Hiding her identity as a Snow Maiden demon, Seolha has carved out a life in disguise among humans. However, her life changes forever when she catches the interest of the Northern Prince, a man known for hunting down and killing demons, and agrees to become his bride. Will those two be able to overcome their differences and live happily ever after?

There are many ways to enjoy a game. Like getting stronger by leveling up, obtaining better items by enhancing, competing against other players in PvP mode... Or getting deeply immersed in the game's world. A simple story centered around the daily life of the protagonist, "Adventurer," and the guild guide NPC, "Emma."

description.en:
I somehow kidnapped the Grand Duke I had a one-sided love for!

To hide this fact we had to pretend being in a relationship, but the Grand Duke is behaving strangely:

"Vivian, may I kiss you?"

Huh? Are we kissing as soon as we started dating?

"We'll kiss, then take take a step further and get married."

Is this relationship going to be alright?

---
Vivian Louis is the twenty-one-year-old daughter of a Count, a sweet and seemingly harmless girl who has only one guilty pleasure in life: thirsting after her crush, the breathtakingly handsome Grand Duke Lennox Elphidion Glenn! For her, it was love at first sight at the tender age of fourteen. That’s when she began obsessing over him, creating endless works of fan art and fan fiction. Then one day, an accident with her best friend’s magical crystal ball makes the unthinkable come true. The grand duke is kidnapped and tied up in her bed, and he’s telling her that she’s the kidnapper! Scrambling for a way out of this scandalous bind, the two agree to act like a couple. They even sign a one-year contract, but Lennox seems to want more than a fake relationship. Unbeknownst to Vivian, a full-blown romance is on its way. Could it be that her wildest fan fantasies will truly come to life?

¡Accidentalmente secuestré al gran duque por el que tengo un amor unilateral! Terminé aceptando la propuesta del gran duque de tener una relación contractual a cambio de solucionar este problema, pero...

"Vivian. ¿Puedo besarte?"

¿Eh? ¿Nos estamos besando tan pronto como comenzamos a salir?

"Nos besaremos, luego llevaremos las cosas más lejos, y luego nos casaremos, Vivian..."

Estoy en un gran problema. ¡No creo que el gran duque esté en su sano juicio...! ¿Está realmente bien esta relación?

Pewnego dnia wydarza się jednak coś niewyobrażalnego — w wyniku wypadku z magiczną kryształową kulą jej najlepszej przyjaciółki... książę zostaje porwany i związany ląduje w jej łóżku! A co gorsza — twierdzi, że to ona jest jego porywaczką! Zdesperowani, by uniknąć skandalu, postanawiają udawać parę. Podpisują nawet roczny kontrakt, ale szybko okazuje się, że Lennox chce czegoś więcej niż tylko udawanego związku. Vivian nie ma pojęcia, że prawdziwy romans właśnie się zaczyna… Czy jej najbardziej szalone fanowskie fantazje naprawdę się spełnią?

description.pt-br: Vivian Louis é a filha de vinte e um anos de um conde, uma garota doce e aparentemente inofensiva que tem apenas um prazer culpado na vida: sedento por sua paixão, o incrivelmente belo grão-duque Glenn! Para ela, foi amor à primeira vista na tenra idade de quatorze anos. Foi quando ela começou a ficar obcecada por ele, criando infinitas obras de fanart e fan fiction. Então, um dia, um acidente com a bola de cristal mágica de sua melhor amiga torna o impensável realidade. O grão-duque é sequestrado e amarrado em sua cama, e ele está dizendo a ela que ela é a sequestradora! Lutando por uma saída dessa situação escandalosa, os dois concordam em agir como um casal. Eles até assinam um contrato de um ano, mas Lennox parece querer mais do que um relacionamento falso. Sem o conhecimento de Vivian, um romance completo está a caminho.

description.en:
I possessed the most powerful villainess in a novel, Countess Edina. To be exact, she is the villainess who attempted to assassinate the male lead, took his 'heart,' and sold it to a neighbouring country. Naturally, I tried everything to avoid the male lead until I got his heart back but for some reason I keep running into him half-dead in the streets! I tried to look away and just leave him there, but his condition was simply too terrible.

"Just this time, and only this time! I'll help you and pretend I don't know anything!"

However, since this keeps happening, I think it would be better to just leave the male lead there next time. I'd rather just be nice to him for once, pay my debt, and get over everything!

"No, I don't need your kindness."

But… I think the male lead despises me too much… Can I survive all this? 

===

"I still remember those days when you would poison me and send assassins after me."

"Oh… haha…"

"Yet, once again, I still love the Countess."

"Wait… what?"

The male lead, who saw me as an enemy just a year ago, is now confessing to me, the villainess.

"Doesn't this make me seem like I'm crazy?"

I was frozen and couldn’t say anything, but it was I who felt crazy.

"But that's okay. Because I am a crazy bastard," he whispered softly to me in a deep voice.

It wasn't that I disliked how he'd changed… Ha. This is all too much. He's exactly my type - What should I do?

description.en:
Louise wants nothing more than to live a happy life with her husband, Reyard. She loves her husband so much even though he has never been faithful to her. She had to watch him bring home mistresses and pretend like she wasn’t bothered by it. After all, Reyard was never deceitful about his wishes. He told her that if she were to object to his lovers then their marriage would be over. Louise feels lower than low, so when Reyard insists that she take on a lover of her own… she does just that.

---
Luise is a woman who married an unfaithful nobleman, who keeps having affairs with other women. Tired of her miserable life, she decides to follow her husband's advice and take a lover for herself. She meets a mysterious man who wears a mask, he is the most famous lover in the underworld.

However, when he takes off his mask, she discovers that he is actually Edward, the grand duke of the empire. Edward is a powerful and dangerous man who has his own plans for Luise. He teaches her to fight, to use magic and to become a strong and independent woman.

Protects her from the dangers that surround her, such as her ex-husband, the emperor and the enemies of the empire. Luise falls in love with Edward, but does he feel the same way about her? And will they be able to stay together amid so much intrigue and conflict?
description.fr: Louise est une femme qui a épousé un noble infidèle, qui ne cesse d'avoir des liaisons avec d'autres femmes. Fatiguée de sa vie misérable, elle décide de suivre le conseil de son mari et de prendre un amant pour elle. Elle rencontre un homme mystérieux qui porte un masque et est l'amant le plus célèbre de la pègre. Cependant, lorsqu'il enlève son masque, elle découvre qu'il s'agit en fait d'Edward, le grand duc de l'empire. Edward est un homme puissant et dangereux qui a ses propres projets pour Louise. Il lui apprend à se battre, à utiliser la magie et à devenir une femme forte et indépendante.
description.ko:
“기억하지 루이제? 내 사생활에 참견하는 순간 이 결혼은 끝이야. 그걸 받아들인 건 당신이고.”

결혼 기간 약 3년.
끊이지 않고 바람을 피우는 남편에게 지친 어느 날,
남편이 정부를 들이라고 했다.

그의 말대로 정부를 구해보려고 뒷골목에서 가장 유명한 지골로를 찾아오긴 했는데…….

“그래서 받아들일 건가요?”
“예. 기꺼이.”

description.pl: Louise nie pragnie niczego więcej niż szczęśliwego życia ze swoim mężem, Reyardem. Bardzo kocha swojego męża, mimo że nigdy nie był jej wierny. Musiała patrzeć, jak sprowadza do domu kochanki i udawać, że jej to nie przeszkadza. W końcu Reyard nigdy nie zdradzał swoich pragnień. Powiedział jej, że jeśli sprzeciwi się jego kochankom, ich małżeństwo dobiegnie końca. Louise czuje się poniżona, więc kiedy Reyard nalega, by wzięła sobie własnego kochanka... robi to.
description.es-la: ¿Lo recuerdas Louisa? En el momento en que interfieras en mi vida privada, este matrimonio se acabará.Tú eres quien lo aceptó al firmar el contrato. Cuando Louisa trató de gritarle, su marido cínicamente le dijo que si quería también podía tener un amante. Louisa se quedó en shock, pero aceptó y le pidió a su amigo que le buscara el mejor amante del imperio para hacerle saber a su marido, qué se siente engañar a alguien. Sin embargo, cuando entró en una posada para encontrar un amante, vio a un hombre enmascarado de apariencia hermosa que la quería ayudar con su venganza. -Quiero que seas mi amante falso. -Ayudaré con gusto a la señora. Cuando el hombre aceptó, se quitó la máscara delante de ella y Louisa sorprendida descubrió que era el gran duque del imperio. ¡¿Por qué está aquí el gran duque?! Louisa no tiene idea de por qué el gran duque Edward aceptó ser su amante, y qué pasará con su marido…¿Logrará su venganza? ¿se divorciará de él?

description.en:
You know, sometimes you just gotta do what you gotta do to survive. Getting hit in the head with a liquor bottle? Yeah, no thanks. If booting my deadbeat dad to the curb is what it takes, then so be it. Who cares about being the 'good' daughter when your skull's not intact?

And honestly, this whole 'rebuilding the family and getting back home' plan? It started with a bit of divine intervention, or so they say about that land. Next thing I know, bam! I became Countess Validus, blessed by the gods and apparently a real estate mogul.

Then the "just trying to make my life easier" snowball started. A little business here, a tiny push towards the Magic Tower there (hey, free research!), pointing out a few flaws in some laws (someone had to!), maybe tossing a sponsorship bone or two (art can be an investment, right?), and... why not, a school? Knowledge is power, and all that jazz.

The thing is, I wasn't exactly expecting a fan club to spring up. My staff acts like I hung the moon. Then this one lord suddenly wants to be my shadow, apparently my word is gospel now, and someone even called me the hope of the nation! And the proposals? Don't even get me started. All I did was try to not get hit in the head again and maybe, just maybe, find a way back to my own couch. Why is everyone acting like I'm some kind of saint? It's beyond me.

그냥 저 편하려고 돈 벌고 명예를 쌓아 가는 것뿐인데

Hazin Nam had always been plagued by nightmares, but one day, he dreams of an apocalyptic world seven years in the future where humans are fighting to survive among demons and zombies. With his ability to switch back and forth between his school life and the oncoming apocalypse, will Hazin be able to prevent what causes the world’s destruction?

Wie durch ein Wunder erhält sie die Chance, ein neues Leben zu beginnen. Um diesmal einem tragischen Ende zu entkommen, wird sie zur Adoptivtochter einer mächtigen Familie. description.en: After ten years of being exploited by Duke Gerwehr for her healing powers, Agnes meets her death in a dungeon. When she wakes up, she finds herself in her uncle's house before she was sold to Duke Gerwehr in the slave market. Desperate for her past life not to repeat itself, she lets Duke Rodwick adopt her and starts her new life with a new name, Tuariche Rodwick. Will she be able to keep her healing powers secret in this notorious family of assassins and find true happiness and love in her new life?

Par miracle, elle recommence une toute nouvelle vie. Pour fuir le destin tragique, elle devient la fille d'une famille puissante, mais à sa grande surprise, cette famille n'est pas une famille ordinaire... Arrivera-t-elle à trouver le bonheur dans cette mystérieuse famille?

I, Kwon Jinha, began feeling sick after reading a romance novel.

I became connected to all the emotions and sensations of the female lead, Elvi.

I even went to the hospital due to severe pain and sorrow but the result said there’s nothing wrong with my body.

So, I ended up sending an email to the novel’s author, begging for the male lead to stop tormenting the female lead. But instead, all I got was a happy reply...

“Do your job properly, Elvi”.

I found myself possessing Elvi’s body in the novel.

I got slapped by the male lead as soon as I possessed Elvi’s body, upon that, I had only one thought.

“The male lead? It’s over if I kill him, right?”
___

По мере выхода новых глав я стала ощущать связь со всеми эмоциями и чувствами главной героини Элви. Мне даже пришлось обратиться в больницу из-за нестерпимой боли и страданий, но обследование показало, что с моим телом всё в порядке. Очнувшись, я оказалась в романе, так ещё и в теле главной героини. Первое, что я ощутила как Элви - это пощёчина от главного героя. После этого у меня была только одна мысль: "Главный герой? "Wait, am I… a squirrel? How, when, why?!" 

I opened my eyes and found myself… as a squirrel. Not just any squirrel, but a divine beast known as the "Sacred Squirrel," treasured for its ability to soothe a wizard's magical power.

Namun, kekuatan sihir milikku sekarang sangat lemah. ** Dengan segala cara agar menjadi manusia dan sekaligus menyerap sedikit kekuatan sihir, diam-diam aku mendekati anak laki-laki yang kelak akan menjadi penjahat. * "‘Kyung!’ Aku meredam kekuatan sihir yang tak terkendali dengan kedua kaki depanku, * ‘Kyugyung!’ Dan juga mengatasi pelayan-pelayan yang bertindak jahat dengan melempar biji pohon ek pada mereka." * "Kyuung.’ Aku merasa kasihan Karena dia tinggal sendirian, jadi aku mengelusnya sampai tertidur... * ‘Uh... hmm.' * Sungguh tak kusangka aku benar-benar akan berubah menjadi manusia. * ‘Sa... salam kenal?’ * Dan itu terjadi di tempat tidurnya! * ### Sesuai dengan cerita aslinya, anak laki-laki yang akan menjadi penjahat itu direkrut dan dibawa ke medan perang. description.en:
“If only I had straightened out that bratty young marquis earlier…!”

Could my luck be any worse?
First, my father’s business went under and my engagement was broken off.
Then I had to become a private tutor just to support my family.
And now… I’m caught up in a rebellion and about to be executed?!

Why should I have to die—because of that spoiled, clueless marquis?
Dragged into treason I didn’t even commit?!
If only I’d had the chance to fix that arrogant brat’s rotten manners and twisted personality back then…
If only I’d had the chance!

When I opened my tightly shut eyes, I found myself back in the past—at age twenty-two.
I sought out the young marquis, who had lost his parents and been placed in the care of a duke, and applied to be his tutor.

Little by little, through effort and patience, the boy began to open his heart to me.
But now… it feels like someone else’s heart is opening too—His Grace, the Duke himself?!
I was in despair because of my miserable life. This all changed when I met him. He is my savior, but… he is also my worst enemy.

A science student who dislikes mathematics, ‘Yeon-joo’, takes a time slip as an anticipated accident. When I open my eyes, there was a woman emperor who ruled the world! Esmeralda, the Count's daughter, is forced to enter into a political marriage by her father. But she asks Alphonse, whom she first met at a ball, to date her, as she wants to find her own destiny. Alphonse's identity turns out to be the Emperor's 'watchdog', who settles cases in the underground society for the Empire. It was Alphonse who started this relationship only to use Esmeralda for his mission, but his heart is gradually drawn to her, rushing without hesitation. Meanwhile, Esmeralda who has been working hard and dating hard gets caught up in the middle of Black German-Iris's conspiracy...

TW: Borderline toxic relationship in the beginning of the series. Please read with caution.

Ternyata identitas aslinya adalah anjing Kaisar, yang menangani peristiwa alam baka. Untuk menggunakannya untuk misi, Alphonse mulai berkencan, tetapi lambat laun menjadi mencintainya saat dia bergegas maju tanpa ragu-ragu. description.en: Ganghyeok is ruined. His gym business is failing and there's no way he can pay off his debts. But one night, while reading his favorite author's latest webnovel, he gets sucked into a world of martial arts fantasy and wakes up as a child monk in the Shaolin temple. There, he must apply his knowledge of modern fitness to survive their strict training, juggle the friends and enemies he makes along the way, and find a way to get back home.
